title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
description: MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und Longevity-Health Behandlungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen. Innerhalb von nur drei Jahren sind wir auf 10 Standorte und mehr als 50.000 Kunden gewachsen. Damit gehören wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen im Bereich der ästhetischen Medizin in Deutschland. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang. In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als die führende Marke für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren. Unser Erfolgsmodell basiert auf einem klaren Anspruch: höchste medizinische Qualität ohne Kompromisse zugänglich für Alle. Unsere Behandlungen werden ausschließlich von Ärzten durchgeführt. Wir arbeiten mit den hochwertigsten Produkten führender Hersteller und setzen auf standardisierte Prozesse, intensive Schulungen und eine konsequent hohe Behandlungs- und Servicequalität. Unser Ziel ist nicht der kurzfristige "Verkauf" einzelner Behandlungen, sondern der Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch Qualität, Vertrauen und ein konstant exzellentes Kundenerlebnis. Der Markt für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity wächst sehr stark. Gleichzeitig verändern sich die Erwartungen der Kunden: Behandlungen sollen professioneller, zugänglicher und selbstverständlicher werden. Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir mit MY HEALTH & BEAUTY aktiv voran. Aufgaben Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 oder 100 Standorte schafft. Wir suchen ausdrücklich keinen Verwalter bestehender Strukturen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Strukturen hinterfragt, Schwachstellen erkennt, Lösungen entwickelt und diese konsequent umsetzt. Jemanden, der strategisch denkt und selbst vor Ort ist, mit Teams arbeitet, Trainings durchführt, Probleme löst und Verantwortung übernimmt. Deine Verantwortung Du trägst die operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Standorte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unsere Operations kontinuierlich weiter. Leadership & People Du führst unsere Kollegen und späteren Führungskräfte und sorgst dafür, dass Führung nicht nur auf dem Papier stattfindet, sondern im täglichen Geschäft spürbar ist. Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst Verantwortlichkeiten. Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig, entwickelst sie weiter. Genauso konsequent gehst du mit Underperformance um. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Recruiting Team dafür, dass unsere Standorte jederzeit mit den richtigen Menschen besetzt sind und wir auch bei starkem Wachstum oder Ausfällen unsere personellen Standards halten. Training & Development Du entwickelst strukturierte Trainings- und Weiterbildungsprogramme für unsere operativen Teams. Du führst Trainings selbst durch und entwickelst gleichzeitig Strukturen, mit denen Wissen innerhalb der Organisation skalierbar weitergegeben werden kann. Du etablierst klare Standards für Onboarding, Führung, Verkauf, Kundenservice und operative Abläufe. Dabei misst du nicht nur, ob Trainings stattgefunden haben, sondern ob sie tatsächlich zu besserer Performance führen. Operational Excellence Du analysierst die operativen Prozesse des Unternehmens und stellst sie kontinuierlich infrage. Was funktioniert, wird standardisiert. Was nicht funktioniert, wird verändert. Was unnötig kompliziert ist, wird vereinfacht. Du entwickelst SOPs, Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse, die für jeden Standort klar verständlich und reproduzierbar sind. Dein Anspruch ist, dass ein Kunde unabhängig vom Standort ein konstant hohes MY-HEALTH-&-BEAUTY-Erlebnis erhält. Performance & KPIs Du definierst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die relevanten operativen KPIs und stellst sicher, dass diese verstanden und konsequent gesteuert werden. Dazu gehören insbesondere Produktivität, Personaleinsatz, Auslastung, Umsatzperformance, Kundenbindung, Servicequalität und operative Effizienz. Wenn ein Standort seine Ziele verfehlt, analysierst du nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern findest heraus, warum. Anschließend entwickelst du konkrete Maßnahmen, definierst Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher. Customer Experience & Qualitätsanspruch Wir wollen nicht durchschnittlich gut sein. Unser Anspruch ist ein außergewöhnlich hohes Niveau in jedem einzelnen Standort. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Standards hinsichtlich Kundenservice, Organisation, Sauberkeit, Auftreten, Kommunikation und operativer Qualität konsequent eingehalten werden. Du erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und greifst ein, bevor aus kleinen Problemen strukturelle Probleme werden. Dein Ziel ist klar: Aus 10 erfolgreichen Standorten eine skalierbare, professionelle Operations-Struktur zu bauen, die auch mit weiteren 20, 30 oder 100 Standorten funktioniert. Qualifikation Diese Position ist bewusst nicht für jeden geeignet. Wir suchen einen außergewöhnlich leistungsorientierten Menschen mit einem sehr hohen eigenen Anspruch. Du solltest bereits bewiesen haben, dass du Menschen führen, operative Strukturen verbessern und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen kannst. Was du zwingend mitbringen solltest Mehrjährige relevante Führungserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen operativen Organisation. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung größerer Teams und mehrerer Führungsebenen. Idealerweise hast du bereits Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte oder dezentrale operative Einheiten getragen. Du hast Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeiter nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern tatsächlich zu entwickeln, zu motivieren und leistungsfähiger zu machen. Du kannst professionelle Trainingskonzepte entwickeln und bist gleichzeitig stark genug in Kommunikation und Auftreten, diese Trainings selbst durchzuführen. Du bist zahlengetrieben und kannst aus KPIs konkrete operative Entscheidungen ableiten. Du hast bereits Prozesse aufgebaut oder grundlegend verbessert und kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Arbeit messbar zu besseren Ergebnissen geführt hat. Du kannst gleichzeitig strategisch und extrem hands-on arbeiten. Du kommunizierst klar, direkt und verbindlich und scheust dich nicht davor, auch unangenehme Entscheidungen zu treffen. Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsgefühl und wartest bei Problemen nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist. Was uns besonders wichtig ist Wir suchen keine Person, die möglichst viele Aufgaben delegiert und Operations hauptsächlich aus Meetings und Reports heraus steuert. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Unternehmen wirklich verstehen will. Jemanden, der regelmäßig in unseren Standorten präsent ist. Der mit Mitarbeitern spricht. Der Kunden beobachtet. Der Prozesse selbst durchläuft. Der Probleme sieht, bevor sie in einem Dashboard auftauchen. Und der anschließend Strukturen schafft, damit diese Probleme dauerhaft gelöst werden. Du solltest einen außergewöhnlich hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Umsetzung haben. Wir arbeiten in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen. Damit gehen Veränderung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und Phasen außergewöhnlicher Belastung einher. Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung nicht an seiner Stellenbeschreibung oder an der Uhr festmacht. Wenn eine wichtige Standorteröffnung ansteht, ein Team Unterstützung benötigt oder ein operatives Problem gelöst werden muss, erwarten wir Ownership und die Bereitschaft, die Extrameile zu gehen. Was für uns zählt, sind Ergebnisse. Dein Mindset Du denkst unternehmerisch. Du willst gestalten statt verwalten. Du stellst hohe Anforderungen an dich selbst und an dein Team. Du kannst Menschen begeistern, aber genauso klare Grenzen setzen. Du bist extrem lösungsorientiert. Du suchst bei Problemen nicht nach Erklärungen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, sondern nach dem schnellsten nachhaltigen Weg, es zu lösen. Du kannst Prioritäten setzen und auch unter erheblichem Druck klar entscheiden. Du hast keine Angst vor Verantwortung. Benefits Was wir dir bieten Eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Entwicklung und Skalierung von MY HEALTH&BEAUTY. Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit attraktivem Fixgehalt und leistungsabhängigem Bonus. Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege. Die Möglichkeit, Strukturen nicht nur zu übernehmen, sondern ein Operations-System für die nächsten 20, 30 oder 100 Standorte aktiv mit aufzubauen. Keine Konzernbürokratie und keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Ideen können schnell entschieden und umgesetzt werden. Und vor allem: eine Rolle, in der du wirklich etwas aufbauen kannst, anstatt lediglich einen bestehenden Betrieb zu verwalten. Du möchtest nicht einfach einen weiteren Job. Du möchtest maßgeblich daran beteiligt sein, ein Unternehmen von 10 Standorten zu der führenden Marken seiner Branche zu skalieren. Wenn du dich darin wiederfindest und bereits nachweislich auf einem hohen Niveau gearbeitet hast, möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>Senior Software Engineer (Java/Angular)</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.&nbsp; Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE OF THE ART TECHNOLOGY</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a talented and inquisitive <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company.&nbsp;</p> <p>Based in London, you will be a key player in designing, building, and evolving our web-based football analytics platform. Working across backend services and frontend UX/UI, you will contribute to a broad range of product capabilities that help professional football teams analyse and work with complex performance data in an intuitive and effective way.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you will take ownership of features from design through implementation and deployment, contribute to technical decisions, and continuously improve the quality of our code, architecture, and development practices. You will work closely with Product and other engineering teams to turn product requirements into reliable, high-quality software that delivers real value to our customers.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute substantially to the design, implementation and maintenance of efficient, reusable and reliable code to solve a variety of customers' needs while considering existing technology, architecture and processes</li> <li>Help drive code quality, organisation and best practices throughout the entire development process and in coordination with team objectives</li> <li>Actively participate in team engineering processes, design meetings and code reviews with the view of continuously lifting quality and improving</li> <li>Contribute to our test strategy by helping define test cases, authoring unit tests and driving automation wherever appropriate</li> <li>Bring a growth mindset to every task -- sharing ideas and opinions with an attitude and appetite for improvement; the ability to challenge, pursue outcomes and take ownership of tasks in a collaborative environment&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of professional software engineering experience, designing, building, and operating production grade applications and services</li> <li>Strong experience with Java / Spring Boot and a modern JavaScript / TypeScript framework such as Angular or React</li> <li>Experience with Kotlin is a plus, but not required</li> <li>Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including data modelling, query design, and performance optimization</li> <li>Strong understanding of API design, distributed systems, and client server architectures</li> <li>Experience with automated testing, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and release automation</li> <li>Ability to take ownership of features and technical solutions from architecture and implementation through to production and ongoing operation</li> <li>Knowledge of Capacitor, Electron, RxDB, or offline capable application development is a plus</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE</strong></h3> <ul> <li>I<strong>n 6 months:</strong> You'll be confidently delivering features across our web analytics platform, contributing across backend services and frontend UX/UI implementation, and shipping high-quality production changes that create real value for our customers.</li> <li><strong>In 12 months</strong>: You'll be owning significant features and parts of the platform end to end, leading their technical design and implementation across backend and frontend, and helping shape how our architecture and engineering practices evolve as the product grows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY CATAPULT?&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious,&nbsp; intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.&nbsp;</li> <li>We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.&nbsp; There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!&nbsp;</p> <p>Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers.<span data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <div> <p>Helsing is building its commercial function to support complex, high-stakes defence campaigns across the UK. As Senior Commercial Manager, you will develop and deliver a commercial strategy aligned with Campaign Leads, Finance, and senior leadership, ensuring Helsing is positioned to win UK defence contracts. You will own commercial negotiations and processes with key partners and suppliers, drawing on deep knowledge of MoD procurement frameworks to drive sound, mission-aligned outcomes. Based in London or the Bristol area, you will work within a cross-functional team and play a central role in shaping how Helsing engages with the UK defence market.</p> </div> <h2><strong>The day-to-day</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and own a commercial strategy that supports active UK defence campaigns, working in close partnership with Campaign Leads, Finance, and senior leadership to ensure commercial positioning is coherent and well-founded</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead end-to-end commercial negotiations with defence partners and suppliers, structuring agreements that protect Helsing's interests and accelerate programme delivery</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage UK defence tender processes from initiation to award, ensuring full compliance with MoD procurement frameworks and internal governance requirements</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide commercial guidance across cross-functional teams, translating complex procurement requirements into clear, actionable advice that enables effective decision-making</p> </li> <li> <p>Monitor the UK defence commercial landscape, identifying emerging opportunities and risks and feeding insight into Helsing's broader campaign and growth strategy</p> </li> </ul> <h2 id="You’ll-do-great-if-you….3" data-renderer-start-pos="15247"><strong>You should apply if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Have built and led commercial strategies within the UK defence sector, with direct experience of MoD tender and contracting processes</p> </li> <li> <p>Have held a commercial role within or alongside a UK defence procurement agency, such as DE&amp;S or the SDA</p> </li> <li> <p>Have led complex, multi-stakeholder commercial negotiations and can demonstrate tangible outcomes from those engagements</p> </li> <li> <p>Can operate fluently across government and industry environments, adapting communication style and approach to suit each audience</p> </li> <li> <p>Can translate broad campaign objectives into structured commercial plans that align finance, legal, and operational requirements</p> </li> </ul> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically</em>&nbsp;<em data-stringify-type="italic">under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.</em></em></p> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="4" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;hybridMultilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="11" data-aria-level="1"> <div><span data-contrast="auto">Familiarity with Maritime domain programmes and the procurement structures that surround them</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></div> </li> </ul> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="4" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;hybridMultilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="12" data-aria-level="1"> <div><span data-contrast="auto">Experience supporting naval or maritime defence campaigns in a commercial capacity</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></div> </li> </ul> <h2><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about</span></p> </li> </ul> <h2 id="What-we-offer" data-renderer-start-pos="3238"><strong><span id="6afa48f9-b797-428b-aa69-0bc8163b3593" data-renderer-mark="true" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="6afa48f9-b797-428b-aa69-0bc8163b3593">What we offer</span></strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Competitive salary </strong>and<strong> VSOP options</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Relocation support</strong>: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Learning</strong>: €500/£450 yearly allowance</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Health &amp; wellness</strong>: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Social</strong>: regularly company events and monthly social allowances</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Enhanced parental leave</strong>: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers &amp; 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Family support:</strong> 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work</p> </li> </ul> <p>These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found <a href="https://helsing.ai/candidate-privacy-and-confidentiality-regime/" target="_blank">here</a>.&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Executive
description: <h3><strong><em>This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.</em></strong></h3> <h2><strong>About Black Forest Labs</strong></h2> <p>We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.</p> <p>Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.</p> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships&nbsp; especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.</p> <p>This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Work On</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises</li> <li>Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams</li> <li>Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing</li> <li>Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion</li> <li>Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals</li> <li>Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research</li> <li>Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <p>You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.</p> <p>You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.</p> <p><strong>You'll likely have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders</li> <li>Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers</li> <li>Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals</li> <li>Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms</li> <li>Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types</li> <li>Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How We Work Together</strong></h2> <p>We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.</p> <p><strong>Everything we do is grounded in four values:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Obsessed.</strong> We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.</li> <li><strong>Low Ego.</strong> The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.</li> <li><strong>Bold.</strong> We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.</li> <li><strong>Kind.</strong> People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.</li> </ul> <p>If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>Base Annual Salary:</strong></p> <p><strong>EU </strong>€150,000 - €185,000 + variable + equity</p> <p><strong>US </strong>$180,000 - $210,000 USD + variable + equity</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.

Be able to communicate with clients on subjects outside your remit, and provide them with useful insight, working independently</li> <li>Develop in-depth knowledge of all paid social platforms and related bid-management platforms, and other methods of buying paid social (e.g. including programmatically-bought via DSPs) operating as in-agency expert in your field of specialism, whilst showing a good understanding of the overall media landscape</li> <li>Manage and develop vendor relationships within paid social, working closely with the Platforms &amp; Emerging Media team where applicable</li> <li>Identifying new platforms, partners &amp; integrations, evaluating these (and existing platforms) over time and maintaining a POV here</li> <li>Develop thought leadership pieces &amp; case studies throughout the course of the year to demonstrate role within wider industry as a display expert</li> <li>Deliver quarterly, semi-annual, or annual updates on work quality as it relates to owned workstreams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> <li>Proven experience at Activation Director level in a Digital Media or Advertising role (including some aspects of managing P&amp;L)​</li> <li>Proven Project Management, Leadership and People Management Experience​</li> <li>Experience with planning and running large-scale paid social activity on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn, either directly or via third party platforms​</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of media planning fundamentals e.g. reach, frequency, channels, formats, etc.​</li> <li>Experience of managing paid social vendor relationships​</li> <li>Regularly contributes to paid social best practices and campaign processes​</li> <li>End of quarter wrap up and review content for biddable campaigns.​</li> <li>Responsible for Biddable media planning and strategy​</li> <li>Experience with Google Analytics (plus certification) desirable​</li> <li>Experience with programmatically-bought paid social activity desirable ​</li> <li>Some experience with paid search, programmatic display &amp; reservation-based buying desirable</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>1833 - Account Executive, Paid Social</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><strong><em>About WPP 650&nbsp; </em></strong></p> <p>Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.</p> <p>Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You’ll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.</p> <p>WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. We bring together the best of WPP's talent, technology, and insights to deliver impactful, modern, and effective public communications. We are at the forefront of reimagining how government engages with its citizens.</p> <p>This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.</p> <p>As&nbsp;<strong>Account&nbsp;Executive</strong>&nbsp;the successful&nbsp;candidate&nbsp;will rapidly develop their knowledge of paid advertising across&nbsp;all&nbsp;the key social channels,&nbsp;from activation through to reporting.&nbsp;They will&nbsp;also learn how to&nbsp;work as part of a team that&nbsp;plan&nbsp;&amp;&nbsp;deliver award-winning work in a busy agency environment&nbsp;that&nbsp;has&nbsp;training + development at its core.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of a busy Paid Social team&nbsp;the role is varied with several areas of focus. Account Executives will be given all the necessary training to help develop the skills&nbsp;required&nbsp;to fulfil their&nbsp;responsibilities. These include:&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>End-to-end set up of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Undertaking regular quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Monitoring campaign performance and pacing to ensure activity delivers as expected.&nbsp;Troubleshooting and optimising campaigns&nbsp;in order to&nbsp;improve&nbsp;performance&nbsp;as necessary.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Working to produce detailed &amp;&nbsp;accurate&nbsp;weekly/monthly campaign performance reports, often in Microsoft Excel.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Writing performance commentary that delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Assisting&nbsp;with more detailed analysis including end-of-campaign reporting, quarterly/annual reviews, and on standalone projects.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Client &amp; Partner Management</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Working closely with your line-manager &amp; the wider team&nbsp;(including the&nbsp;Global&nbsp;Hub&nbsp;team)&nbsp;to support the delivery of high-quality work for clients.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Working with partners and attending regular platform training&nbsp;sessions&nbsp;to further develop&nbsp;your&nbsp;paid social skillset.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Responsible for managing your workload and for communicating&nbsp;clearly and&nbsp;in a timely manner&nbsp;with internal and external stakeholders as&nbsp;required&nbsp;across email, chat,&nbsp;video&nbsp;and in-person.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Attend regular internal meetings and training sessions&nbsp;in order to&nbsp;actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Responsible for following the mandatory agency finance processes.&nbsp;Working with line-manager and to ensure processes are followed, allowing for prompt payment/invoicing and to minimise finance queries.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>The Account Executive position is aimed at someone passionate about starting a career in digital marketing and paid social. We are looking for a candidate with the following attributes:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Display an&nbsp;eagerness to learn.&nbsp;You should be diligent and attentive to detail, able to listen, learn new skills, and put these into practice quickly.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Able to&nbsp;display in interest in how digital advertising/marketing works&nbsp;(especially&nbsp;on&nbsp;social media&nbsp;channels)&nbsp;and a&nbsp;have&nbsp;desire to&nbsp;further&nbsp;your knowledge&nbsp;in this area.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Computer literate with&nbsp;a&nbsp;good&nbsp;base of&nbsp;skills&nbsp;across the&nbsp;Microsoft Office&nbsp;suite of programmes&nbsp;(including Excel).&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Being&nbsp;part of a busy agency environment&nbsp;we&nbsp;regularly work&nbsp;with&nbsp;large amounts&nbsp;of&nbsp;data so&nbsp;a confidence with numbers is&nbsp;also&nbsp;a must.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Teamwork is key&nbsp;to&nbsp;this&nbsp;role&nbsp;and we are looking for someone who is&nbsp;collaborative, friendly,&nbsp;and with a can-do attitude.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when&nbsp;we're&nbsp;together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;That's&nbsp;why&nbsp;we’ve&nbsp;adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="3"><span data-path-to-node="3,1"><span class="citation-2853">You own AI capabilities end-to-end:&nbsp; from the data and context that feed a model, through agent orchestration, to the generative UI a user sees and trusts. You've built against a generative/agent-driven UI protocol, not just consumed a REST API</li> <li>The AI spine: prompt/context engineering, agents, tool use, structured outputs, evals, MCP Python and TypeScript/Node + React; comfortable with async, streaming, and observability</li> <li>Working fluency with retrieval/embeddings and SQL</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="13"><span data-path-to-node="13,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,0" data-index-in-node="0"><span class="citation-2822">Nice to Have:</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Fine-tuning/distillation, e-commerce or marketplace systems, and a track record in 0→1</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human centred AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK.

When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK.

About the role

As a Principal Data Scientist at Faculty, you will drive high impact transformation within our Defence team by taking ownership of complex machine learning delivery and sector specific strategy. You will act as a trusted technical authority and domain expert, leading project scoping, technical selling, and client management to deliver exceptional value. Balancing deep business knowledge with advanced analytical skill, you will shape cutting edge AI solutions, build robust client partnerships, and mentor data scientists across ambitious initiatives.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning and growing a strategic portfolio of machine learning work specifically tailored to the Defence sector.

  • Translating client challenges into technical roadmaps by leading project scoping, delivery, and client engagement.

  • Writing exemplary, production grade code to set technical standards on our most sophisticated delivery projects.

  • Serving as a technical authority on machine learning across Faculty and representing our capabilities within the wider community.

  • Partnering with commercial and delivery teams to drive technical selling, pitching, and business growth.

  • Mentoring and guiding junior data scientists through complex problem solving, technical planning, and execution.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring deep domain expertise within Defence or other industries, allowing you to quickly spot opportunities and maximise impact.

  • You enjoy mentoring junior colleagues and have prior direct management experience, inspiring them to continually stretch and grow their technical skill.

  • You bring broad knowledge across a range of machine learning techniques, including experience building Generative AI and agentic AI applications with Large Language Models

  • You have advanced coding skills in Python and proven experience building and maintaining scalable codebases.

  • You excel at making pragmatic decisions, choosing optimal solutions based on time, resources, and complexity.

  • You are an engaging communicator who builds trust effortlessly with senior stakeholders and technical counterparts.

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to Business Unit Technical Director (30 minutes)

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial & Principles Interview (90 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Guide technical direction and architecture across fullstack web, backend and mobile squads, without needing to be deeply hands-on with code

  • Bring coherence across distinct areas, railcards growth and retention, subscriptions and customer value exchange, ensuring technical strategy connects them where it matters

  • Champion engineering best practices across teams, promoting quality and a culture of technical innovation

  • Drive operational excellence, ensuring teams have robust monitoring, alerting and incident management processes in place
